title: Threat Level Midnight
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael Scott finally completes and screens his long-awaited movie 'Threat Level Midnight' to his office. The film follows Michael Scarn, a secret agent, as he battles his nemesis Goldenface who threatens the NHL All Star Game with a bomb hidden in a puck. The movie features action-packed scenes including hockey training, hostage situations, and dramatic confrontations. Meanwhile, Michael faces personal struggles, including tension with Holly over her reaction to the film. The office watches the movie with mixed reactions, and the episode ends with Michael receiving a call for another mission, leaving some story outcomes uncertain.

main_threads.thread: Michael completes and screens his self-made movie 'Threat Level Midnight', which centers on secret agent Michael Scarn's mission to stop Goldenface from bombing the NHL All Star Game.
